primary_item.summary:
Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 generates complete 3D games from single prompts, including a first-person shooter, a kart racer, and a Minecraft clone, all without a single external asset. Geometry, textures, physics, and in some cases music are produced as code and run directly in the browser.
